name: storage-vercel-blob
title: Storage: Vercel Blob
description: Implements lib/storage/* with Vercel Blob (direct client uploads, auth-checked token route). Requires env BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN (vercel blob store / Vercel dashboard). Replaces the base stubs: install with --overwrite.
docs: Set BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN (create a Blob store in the Vercel dashboard and run `vercel env pull .env.local`). Upload with uploadFile() from lib/storage/client.ts.
